subject: Turnout among the gettable (low-engagement voters), by institutional grievance
source: ANES 2016 Time Series (data/raw/anes_timeseries_2016.dta), weighted by V160101.
sample: Self-reported low-interest voters (V161004=3). Grievance terciles taken WITHIN this subset.
turnout_metric: V162031x self-report (0=no, 1=yes). Vote-validated currently unavailable (voteval CSV not loaded).
caveats: Self-report over-reports turnout ~25pp vs validated benchmarks; absolute levels are inflated, gradient shape is the reliable signal.
Cell n is 100-200 per band; treat the hump as suggestive, gradients (stakes ↑, efficacy ↓) as reliable.
Efficacy gradient computed within low-engagement subset; the full-sample efficacy gradient (which §14 [1] currently cites at 2.74→2.28) is steeper because efficacy is partly age/education-driven.
